description:
OpenADMET Octant CYP Inhibition & Reactivity
	

Data release from the OpenADMET consortium, generated by Octant Bio.
This dataset accompanies the blog post Building the OpenADMET Data Engine.
Source code, assay protocols, and raw TSV files are on GitHub.

Cytochrome P450 (CYP) enzymes drive the oxidative metabolism of most drugs and are a primary cause of drug-drug interactions (DDIs).

author: openadmet
description:
OpenADMET AHR Induction
	

Experimental measurements of aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) induction, produced by OpenADMET
from Octant Bio cell-based reporter assays. AHR is a ligand-activated bHLH-PAS transcription
factor; agonists drive expression of CYP1A1/CYP1A2/CYP1B1 and related genes, which makes AHR
activation relevant to drug-drug interactions and to off-target toxicity.
The dataset covers three assay tiers from the same screening campaign: a single-concentration
primary… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/openadmet/ahr-induction.

author: openadmet
description:
OpenADMET pKa (SiriusT3)
	

Experimentally measured aqueous pKa values for 717 small molecules, produced through the
OpenADMET-Schrodinger collaboration.
pKa describes the pH-dependent equilibrium between protonation states differing by a single proton,
and is one of the most fundamental descriptors of a small molecule — it shapes expectations for
solubility, permeability and broader ADME behaviour. The compound set was chosen deliberately to
